modules.title: Introduction to C++ & Getting Started
modules.content: C++ is a powerful, general-purpose programming language developed by Bjarne Stroustrup. It supports both low-level and high-level programming, making it suitable for systems programming and application development.
summary: C++ is a compiled and statically typed language.
cout is used for output, cin for input.
Variables must be declared before use.
const keyword is used for constants.

quiz.question: Which is correct way to print Hello?

modules.title: Operators, Control Flow & Loops
modules.content: Operators perform operations on variables. Control flow statements like if-else and loops control program execution.
summary: for loop is used when iterations are known.
while loop runs based on condition.

quiz.question: Which loop runs at least once?

modules.title: Functions, Arrays & Pointers
modules.content: Functions help reuse code. Arrays store multiple values. Pointers store memory addresses.
modules.code: int add(int a, int b){ return a+b; }
summary: Dynamic memory uses new and delete.

modules.title: Object-Oriented Programming in C++
modules.content: OOP includes encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and abstraction using classes and objects.

modules.title: Templates, STL, File I/O & Exception Handling
modules.content: Templates allow generic programming. STL provides data structures. File I/O handles files.
modules.code: template<typename T> T add(T a, T b){ return a+b; }
